identity.title: [v0.92.1][planning] Create corporate transfer, C-SDLC v3, and distributed Runtime milestone

values.goal: Create a complete, execution-ready v0.92.1 milestone package spanning corporate and IP transfer, C-SDLC v3 implementation, and distributed multi-agent Runtime validation.
values.required_outcome: A reviewed milestone package defines three independently executable lanes, complete child issue specifications and dependencies, bounded proof requirements, release gates, and truthful routing from the superseded v0.92.5 draft and reviewed C-SDLC v3 architecture.
authority_boundary: This issue creates planning authority but does not execute legal transfer, C-SDLC v3 implementation, or Runtime deployment.
Final legal instruments require qualified counsel review and corporate approval.
The reviewed C-SDLC v3 Rust architecture remains the source design authority; this issue allocates and operationalizes its implementation wave.
Distributed Runtime proof must consume existing implementation issues and may identify defects without silently absorbing their remediation.
operator_constraints: Never write tracked changes on main.
Use the typed C-SDLC v2 lifecycle and a bound FastWork worktree.
Keep the three lanes independently operable and parallelizable.
Use focused documentation, YAML, link, and graph validation only; do not run broad Rust/runtime tests for planning-only changes.
Do not claim completion, approval, transfer, or runtime proof without retained evidence.
